findings.title: Global traffic manager
findings.detail: Azure Front Door fronts microservices in East US and West Europe with health probes enforcing active-active routing during normal operations.

findings.title: Dual-region API mesh
findings.detail: Each active region runs a full API tier with regional load balancers; shared configuration propagates through GitOps within minutes.

findings.title: Cosmos dual-write policy
findings.detail: Cosmos DB multi-region writes require conflict resolution tuned per container with explicit audit when merge rules override analysts.
